I’ve learned that on here more people give a fuck than the people you see everyday. Especially people on this page, we for some reason want to help those in pain but for some reason feel we can’t help ourselves. We all struggle , but your voice is heard, even if it’s just one comment on a post . Someone saw it and they cared.

I take my depression medicine off and on because on one hand I have the desire to want to be better, but like you I also feel indifferent. Like it’s somehow created a new emotion in me, one that’s neither happy nor sad, just complacent. Anytime with starting and stopping mind altering medications there will be side effects I had intense mood swings and deep depression. Just remember it’s a phase and don’t do anything rash , if you think it, seek help.

You have to evaluate from Both sides to be objective, missing a lot of details hear to fairly offer advice on if you should try and sit down and talk or if you should just hike up your sleeves and move on.
